name: Institutional Dark
principles: paper/certificate moments contrast with the dark application shell
constraints: Do not use neon gradients or glossy sci-fi styling.
Do not expose internal channel/family/route/FIX labels in normal player mode.
Do not use faction reputation bars.
Do not show a life-progress percentage because maximum life length is unknown.
Use CSS/system fonts only in H2A; no downloaded font dependency.
playbackRules: 1x is 30% slower than H2A v0.1 based on first human playtest feedback.
2x remains exactly twice the reveal rate of 1x.
These values affect presentation timing only and never RNG or simulation results.
